name: Box-office France
source: fr.wikipedia "Box-office France <year>", 1945-2026, resolved to TMDB ids via Wikidata
note: Admissions, not revenue, so ticket-price inflation never enters. Francophone films only, decided by TMDB original_language rather than the page's country column — a country rule admitted Hollywood blockbusters carrying Canadian co-production credits. Ranked by admissions.
